items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: There'd be only one brother that lived in the night, that's John. Yeah. He got a barber shop.

ctx.x: ...Casa? Ask him about the Casa. What about Casa?

Casa? Casa? You're here talking in there. We used to play the Casa a lot of times too, you know. And I don't know but... ...if he had to come to my house that day, he might have been living today. When he first come back from California, he come to see me. And he say, what you doing, Dad? I said, nothing man, time. Kind of... ...dove down there. He says, uh... ...well, why don't you... ...we and you get together and get up a little four or five piece bag? I said, that's what I've been waiting for. I said, I think…
Ask him why he's got Zeb and Ernest Kelly together. Zeb was a fine fella. You see what?
